title: _strip_heredocs treats << in quotes and arithmetic as a heredoc, and reads no command in a heredoc body
detail:
Sentinel on 0.238.3. Each deletes a in real bash and the gate names nothing: 'echo "use <<EOF in docs"
rm a
EOF', 'echo $((1<<2))
rm a
2', and $(rm a) or a backtick inside an unquoted heredoc body. Same on 0.238.2. The stripper is quote-blind, so it should run over _literal_text_mask, and an unquoted body should keep its substitutions.
